easy_question: This image was supposed to show a flat texture sheet for a blocky voxel game -- a square sheet with small rectangular patches of flat colour scattered on an empty background, the way a skin file looks opened in an image editor. Ignoring artistic quality, does the image actually SHOW that kind of flat sheet of scattered rectangular patches? Answer NO if it instead shows a character standing up, a portrait, a preview of a model, a blank card, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_eyes: This picture is one small square cut out of a texture sheet: it is the character's FACE. What colour are the eyes on this face? Answer with one colour word only.
reference.q_main: This picture is one patch cut out of a texture sheet. What is the main colour of this patch -- the colour that covers most of it? Answer with one colour word only.
reference.q_stripe: This picture is one narrow upright strip cut out of a texture sheet: it is the front of a sleeve. Is there a WHITE stripe running down this strip? Answer yes or no only.
